title: Amended EBA Guidelines on CDD Risk Factors (EBA/GL/2022/11)
raw_content:
EBA Guidelines on CDD risk factors (EBA/GL/2022/11) — AMENDED

15 August 2024

These amended guidelines update the CDD risk factor guidelines. They apply from 1 January 2025.

Section 2a: Crypto-asset specific risk factors [NEW]

When assessing ML/TF risk for virtual asset transactions, institutions must consider privacy coin usage, mixing services, and FATF high-risk jurisdiction exposure.

Section 3: Enhanced due diligence triggers [AMENDED]

EDD is now mandatory for: customers with virtual asset volumes exceeding EUR 10,000/month [NEW]; customers using privacy-enhancing technologies for payment [NEW].
previous_raw_content:
EBA Guidelines on CDD risk factors (EBA/GL/2022/11)

1 November 2022

These guidelines apply from 1 May 2023.

Section 3: Enhanced due diligence triggers

EDD is mandatory for: high-risk third countries; PEPs; transactions with no apparent economic purpose; complex or unusually large transactions.
